name: Conjure Woodland Beings
body:
School conjuration (summoning); Level bard/skald 4, druid 4, hunter 4, ranger 4, shaman 4, witch 4

CASTING

Casting Time 1 round
Components V, S, DF

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Effect one summoned creature
Duration 1 round/level (D)
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions like summon nature’s ally IV, except that you can summon one dryad, 1d3 leprechauns or unicorns, or 1d4+1 atomies or grigs.
